title: A passing drama is too short for waste
summary: This brief body should not be spent as though the drama were permanent. Let mortality pull the tongue away from gossip and back toward deeds that remain.
takeaway: Let mortality clean the tongue before the hour is wasted.
lifeApplication: Before gossip, doomscrolling, or one more petty chase, feel the body's fragility in the breath and ribs. Spend the next word on what you would not be ashamed to carry.

source.shortMeaning: This brief body should not be spent as though the drama were permanent.
